shared_prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: one individual art-only illustration for the original satirical tabletop card game The Great Escalation. Landscape 3:2 composition, 1536x1024 framing. Hand-inked late-1980s editorial comic with dense crosshatching and stipple, aged cream newsprint, charcoal-black shadows, oxblood red, amber yellow and muted petrol teal accents, slightly offset screen-print grain. Rich expressive characters, detailed physical equipment and original visual satire, a clear main silhouette readable at card size. Same coherent world of retro newsrooms, corporate disaster theater and exhausted competent technicians. No card typography, captions, readable words, letters, digits, borders, logos, pyramid-and-eye symbols, watermarks, or recognizable real public figures. Keep critical action in the central 85% of the canvas.

scenes.name: Anonymous Sources
